ATC Vet — QN02AF01. (butorphanol) Pharmacopoeias. In US. USP 31 (Butorphanol Tartrate). A white powder. Its solutions are slightly acidic. Sparingly soluble in water; insoluble in alco- hol, in chloroform, in ether, in ethyl acetate, and in hexane; slightly soluble in methyl alcohol; soluble in dilute acids. Store in airtight containers at a temperature of 25°, excursions permit- ted between 15° and 30°. Dependence and Withdrawal As for Opioid Analgesics, p.101. Butorphanol may have a lower potential for producing depend- ence than pure agonists such as morphine. However, it has been subject to abuse (see under Precautions, below). Abruptly stop- ping chronic butorphanol has produced a less severe withdrawal syndrome than with morphine
